description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Development Applications' card in the
Development section.

Development applications in the suburb, newest first, with category counts.

Paginated with `limit`/`offset`: `total_available` is every application we
hold for the suburb, `total` is how many this page returned, and
`next_offset` is the next page's offset (null on the last). `min_date` /
`max_date` span the full history. Each page is one call at a flat price.

**Price: 15¢ per call.**

offset.description: Application offset — page with `limit`. `next_offset` in the response is the value for the next page (null on the last).
